positive_snippets:
We went to their AK Cocktail Bar to celebrate a birthday. We loved this place, its situated inside karma lakelands and its beautifully decorated and its a quiet place. Kourse and AK Cocktail Bar are in the same building and their kitchen and menu is also same. Their service is so fast and food quality is also good.
We attended by Lama and she was so sweet. She took our beautiful pictures as well.

Best stay in Manesar. Lush green property with so much area and activities that you will enjoy your stay.
If you are gold lover then this is one of the best place to enjoy your game along with family enjoying other games like pickle ball, pool table, carrom, chess etc.
You can explore property and that makes it amazing.

If you need to enjoy serene peace and calmness of nature with your family and friends..then this is the right place.
I have been to karma chalets and kooves but loved chalets more. Since I don't like winters a lot.. felt chalets was more cozy and comfortable.
The food is great. Staff is overly hospitable and help you.
negative_snippets:
We booked a 3 bedroom  villa for our two days stay. Our two daughters were visiting with their 3 kids all below 5 years.  While the resort is  5star  there were a few things I would like to highlight to the management and the owners.
The menu was not kid friendly..except fries they could not eat anything for lunch & dinner. For breakfast on both days they had dosa as the idli were with gunpowder and spicy. A margarita pizza came laden with black pepper..despite telling the server that no spice or  garnishing.  The staff seemed unaware and not trained to take orders.
The helper provided at the villa was very helpful and available at all calls...but what surprised us was that there was no kitchen, no microwave or provision of ice in the mini fridge provided.  No crockery. On request a microwave was provided..with small kids who were milk dependent it became very hard to manage their feeds. The kids slipped from the stairs and got a bump which required an ice pack right away...as there was no ice in the fridge it took 15 mins for the ice to arrive.  When it was clearly that we are checking in with small children a villa with 2 bedrooms on first floor was not a good idea by the booking team.
The room locker did not function and only one key was provided which had to be inserted to get power to the room. On two occasions the room got locked and we had to wait for 40 minutes to get someone to open it...what if a small kid was locked inside.
The management and the owners need to look into these serious matters..
This was my 5th visit and stay. Besides staying in the Chalet, the container room this one we were looking forward to experience the villa..only if the comfort and convenience was looked into it could have been an memorable experience.
Also Neem under the tree was under renovation, this was not mentioned to us.
The kids still enjoyed as the petting farm and boating was fun for them and the golfcart ride was an experience they enjoyed..but for the price we paid  who pay such huge price need better services
